briefdescription.para: Creates and validates the signed authentication tokens. (Originally: "Implementation for tokenmanager: Signs a JWT from the client's identity and writes it back to @p clientLoginData.").

detaileddescription.para: This file builds a JWT from the client's username, id, group and last-logout time, signs it with the configured secret, and later decodes and validates tokens presented by clients. The coroutine form awaits the asynchronous validation path.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Tokens are what a client carries after login to prove who they are on later requests. This file is both the badge printer and the badge checker. Without it, no request could be tied back to a logged-in user.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
JWT (JSON Web Token): https://jwt.io/introduction
HMAC / HS256 signing: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HMAC
Claims (the fields inside a JWT): https://jwt.io/introduction
C++ coroutines: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/coroutines
